verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a public, versioned programmatic surface: an MCP endpoint at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP that needs only the URL and an API key. Per-integration API keys are created in Settings, and an official CLI covers projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks, with stable additive-only `--json` output for scripts, agents and cron. missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP endpoint reference beyond MCP, detail on key scopes and permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
